PoisonTrail.name: Poison Trail
PoisonTrail.tooltip:
Toggle: Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals @DamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second.
Cloud duration: @CloudDuration@ seconds.
Poison duration: @PoisonDuration@ seconds.
Approximate total damage: @ApproximateTotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage.
If a minion would be killed by minion damage while under the effects of Poison Trail, Singed claims the kill credit instead.

Fling.name: Fling
Fling.tooltip:
Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing @BaseDamage@ plus @MaxHPDamage@% max Health magic damage.

If Singed flings a target into his Mega Adhesive, they are Rooted for @RootDuration@ seconds.
Max Health damage is capped at 300 against minions and jungle monsters.

InsanityPotion.name: Insanity Potion
InsanityPotion.tooltip: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him @StatAmount@ <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor>, <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>, <speed>Move Speed</speed>, <healing>Health Regen</healing>, and <scaleMana>Mana Regen</scaleMana> for @Duration@ seconds. During this effect, Singed's <spellName>Poison Trail</spellName> also applies @GrievousAmount*100@% Grievous Wounds for @GrievousDuration@ second.

MegaAdhesive.name: Mega Adhesive
MegaAdhesive.tooltip: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, <status>Grounding</status> and <status>Slowing</status> enemies in the area by @SlowPercent@% for @WDuration@ seconds.
